meta.name: Murdaugh Murders A Southern Scandal
meta.description: Shocking tragedies shatter a tight-knit South Carolina community and expose the horrifying secrets of its most powerful family.

videos.title: Where Is Mallory?
videos.overview: Survivors reflect on the shocking boat crash that killed vibrant teenager Mallory Beach – and the demons that haunted troubled driver Paul Murdaugh.

videos.title: Murders at Moselle
videos.overview: In the aftermath of Mallory’s death, Alex Murdaugh’s damage control raises alarm. Two years later, he is at the center of another horrifying event.

videos.title: No Secrets Are Safe
videos.overview: As the deaths of Maggie and Paul make headlines worldwide, past "accidents" spur new accusations, driving Alex to a seemingly desperate act.
